bug_summary: v1's sync skip gate compared only the registry hash, so a corrupted/hand-edited on-disk projection would still be silently skipped on the next --check/--apply. RENDER_FINGERPRINT_VERSION + hook_render_fingerprint() key the cache on {registry sha256, render version, harness, perf tier}; the cache record also stores content_sha256 of the last-written file so should_skip_hook_render() re-renders whenever the on-disk file's hash no longer matches what wagents last wrote, even if the registry itself is unchanged.
scope_note: Wired into the three fully-owned (non-merge) hook projection writers: Cursor repo hooks.json, Codex repo/home hooks.json, and GitHub Copilot .github/hooks/policy.json. Claude/Gemini settings merges keep their existing full read-merge-write idempotency (write_json byte comparison) since they interleave hooks with MCP/other managed keys and cannot safely skip the read step.
